description: Configuration schema describing parameters for scikit-learn's `make_classification` used to generate synthetic classification datasets.
note: Parameters and defaults are compatible with scikit-learn 1.x series. If you use a different version, verify parameter availability and defaults.

n_samples.description: The number of samples (rows) to generate. If int, will return exactly this many samples. If None, behavior depends on caller code.

n_features.description: Total number of features. These comprise informative, redundant and repeated features.

n_informative.description: The number of informative features, i.e. features that are actually useful to build the class label. Must be <= n_features.

n_redundant.description: The number of redundant features, generated as linear combinations of the informative features.

n_repeated.description: The number of duplicated features, drawn randomly from the informative and the redundant features.

n_classes.description: The number of classes (targets) to generate.

n_clusters_per_class.description: The number of clusters per class. Each class may be composed of one or more clusters.

weights.description: Class weights. If None, classes are balanced. If a list, it should contain n_classes floating point values that sum to 1. If one value is provided, it is treated as the relative weight for class 0 and the remainder is distributed evenly among remaining classes.

flip_y.description: The fraction of samples whose class are randomly exchanged to introduce noise (label noise). Must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

class_sep.description: Separability between classes. Larger values make classes more easily separable.

hypercube.description: If True, clusters are put on the vertices of a hypercube. If False, clusters are put on the vertices of a random polytope.

shift.description: Shift applied to the features. Can be a float (applied to all features) or an array of length n_features.

scale.description: Scaling applied to the features. Can be a float (applied to all features) or an array of length n_features.

shuffle.description: If True, shuffles the samples and the features. If False, samples are ordered by class.

random_state.description: Controls the randomness of the generator. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. Also accepts a numpy RandomState instance.
